# Contract: glaze

SumitCraft addition. Category: design. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Install ready Glaze React components (interfaces, AI chat, voice, animated icons) one at a time, in one of four finishes, before writing a component by hand.

## Use it for
- "build this AI chat with Glaze"
- "add a glass voice orb to my Next.js app"

## Not for
- choose a visual direction from scratch (glyph)
- audit existing UI code against guidelines (web-design-guidelines)
- React performance rules (react-best-practices)

## Accepted inputs
A React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4 project, ideally already initialised with shadcn.

## Deliverables
The Glaze theme installed once, then the named components, with a finish set on html or on one region.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- none

Optional:
- Node.js 18.19+

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Installing a component runs the shadcn CLI, which fetches that component's registry item from GitHub (sumitttt4/glazeui). The skill itself does not call an API.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None. Glaze's components are free.

## Workflow
1. Prerequisites
2. Install the theme once
3. Browse, then install one component
4. Pick a finish and compose
5. If the source is needed without installing

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Which finish (Normal, Glass, Frost, Aurora)
- Which components to install

## Quality checks
- The theme was installed before any component
- The stylesheet imports glaze.css and materials.css
- Imports come from the installed files, not a hand-written substitute

## Common failures
- Components look unstyled because the theme step was skipped
- Glass or Frost with nothing behind them

## Limitations
- Guidance. The components are not copied into this repo. Not run here.
- The live registry was read on 2026-11-14; names can change upstream

## Reproducible example
Not run in this import. Commands are the ones published in the Glaze README and llms.txt.
